About this preview

Where does this page live?

Under /preview/ on vfempire.com, alongside other work-in-progress builds. The whole preview tree is served with noindex, nofollow, kept out of the sitemap, and never linked from public pages. Share the URL only with people we want in the review.

Why is the file 15.7 MB instead of 374?

The raw capture is 3782 × 2080 at 22 Mbps. Cloudflare Workers Assets caps a single file at 25 MiB, and even without that limit no one wants to load a third of a gigabyte to give feedback. NVENC on the 4080 rescales to 1920 wide, targets 1 Mbps VBR, and writes +faststart so the video begins playing before the whole file lands.

Is this the finished SnapIT reel?

No. This is the source. The public reel gets a cut down, on-brand titling, and end-card, and lives inside /systems/snapit once that product page ships. The purpose of this page is to review the raw run and pull the frames and copy the reel needs.

What happens after review?

Notes come back as comments on this preview or by email. The reel is cut, stills are exported, copy is locked, then the preview folder is removed and the reel is embedded on the product page. Anything worth keeping goes into the SnapIT press kit.
